entries.description: the Buddha was staying near Vesālī
entries.subject: the Buddha

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Vesālī, at the Great Wood, in the hall with the peaked roof.
Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pavutto abhabbo haritattāya; Suppose there was a fallen, withered leaf.

entries.description: the imperturbable has dropped the connection with worldly pleasures of the flesh
entries.subject: the imperturbable
entries.object: dropped the connection with worldly pleasures of the flesh

spans.text: In the same way, an individual intent on the imperturbable has dropped the connection with worldly pleasures of the flesh.

entries.task_id: suppose there|was|a broad rock that had been broken in half
entries.description: Suppose there was a broad rock that had been broken in half
entries.subject: Suppose there
entries.object: a broad rock that had been broken in half

spans.text: Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, puthusilā dvedhābhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti; Suppose there was a broad rock that had been broken in half, so that it could not be put back together again.

entries.description: of nothingness has broken the connection with the imperturbable
entries.subject: of nothingness
entries.object: broken the connection with the imperturbable

spans.text: In the same way, an individual intent on the dimension of nothingness has broken the connection with the imperturbable.
Taṁ kiṁ maññasi, sunakkhatta, What do you think, Sunakkhatta?

spans.text: “In the same way, an individual intent on the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception has vomited the connection with the dimension of nothingness.

entries.subject: Suppose there

entries.task_id: on extinguishment|has|cut off the connection with the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception at the root

entries.object: cut off the connection with the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception at the root

spans.text: In the same way, an individual rightly intent on extinguishment has cut off the connection with the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception at the root, made it like a palm stump, obliterated it, so it’s unable to arise in the future.
